task_summary: Researched Claude Code skills system online, created test skill files (.claude/skills/) in the Claudia project, and verified skills work through the SAP AI Core proxy
mistakes: Initially tried to create a task via test-cli but encountered message format issues - could have just tested the skill directly first
Started the server unnecessarily when it may have already been running or could have been tested differently

learnings.trigger: When testing Claude Code skills/slash commands
learnings.insight: Skills are just markdown files in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md - they work through any proxy since they're instructions loaded into context, not API-dependent features

learnings.trigger: When creating custom Claude Code skills
learnings.insight: Skills directory structure: .claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter (name, description) and markdown instructions. Supports $ARGUMENTS for dynamic input

learnings.trigger: When the Claudia server isn't running
learnings.insight: Use ./start.sh to start the server, but check CLAUDE.md first - it warns against restarting while tasks are running to avoid OOM crashes
